title: Impact of Police Staffing on Crime Rates
research_question: Does an increase in police staffing lead to a reduction in crime rates? To address the potential endogeneity between police count and crime rates, we use a cops grant lottery as an instrumental variable for police staffing levels.
data_description: The dataset includes 300 observations with columns: y (crime rate), x (police count), z (cops grant lottery), and controls (various socioeconomic factors). The grant lottery serves as an exogenous source of variation in police staffing.
